fee_schedule.rounding_rule: PARTIALLY VERIFIED: docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/fee_rounding (retrieved 2026-07-21) states trade fee rounds UP to the nearest $0.0001, then a 'rounding fee' floors balance_change to the user's target balance precision ($0.01 for non-direct members, $0.0001 for direct members), charging the difference; net fee = trade fee + rounding fee - rebate (>= $0.00); a $0.01 rebate is issued once accumulated rounding exceeds $0.01. This is a per-order, multi-fill accumulator mechanism; its single-fill, unit-stake simplification for a non-direct/standard account is: settle to whole-cent precision. Account tier (direct vs. non-direct) applicable to this research is NOT independently confirmed.
